tictactoe_rules: The classic 3x3 grid game. The goal is to form a line, column or diagonal with three identical symbols before your opponent.
reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the scores?
memory_rules: Test your memory by finding all pairs of identical cards in the shortest number of moves possible.
sudoku_rules: Fill the 9x9 grid so that every row, column, and 3x3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 without any repetitions.
battleship_rules: Position your ships and try to guess where the enemy fleet is hidden to sink it completely.
wordsearch_rules: Locate all the words from the list hidden in the grid of letters. They can be in any direction.
hangman_rules: Discover the hidden word by selecting letters one by one. You have a limited number of allowed mistakes.
diff_easy_desc: Fast learning, smaller amount of options.
diff_hard_desc: The ultimate test for your logical skills.
desc_tt_pvp: Play against a friend by sharing the same screen.
bs_pve_desc: Play against our Artificial Intelligence Fleet Commander.
bs_pvp_desc: Pass the Kindle to play against a friend locally.
pass_device: Pass the device and tap when ready.
connect4_rules:
From the Menu, pick Red (goes first) or Yellow (second). Tap a column to drop a piece.

Connect 4 pieces of the same color horizontally, vertically or diagonally to win.
crosswords_rules:
Tap a square to select.
Tap again to toggle between Across and Down.
Use the onscreen keyboard to input letters.
bs_manual_start: Tap to start placing your ships.
dots_rules: The goal is to close as many squares as possible. Click between two points to draw a line. Whoever closes a square scores a point and plays again.
sinister_rules: One player reads the situation aloud. The others ask 'yes' or 'no' questions to figure out what really happened. When someone knows the answer, they try to explain. If wrong, the game continues until someone gets it right or everyone gives up.
sinister_s1_situation: A man walks into a bar and asks for a glass of water. The bartender points a gun at him. The man smiles, says thank you, and leaves.
sinister_s1_solution: The man had hiccups. The bartender noticed and scared him with the gun to cure them. The hiccups stopped and he thanked him.
sinister_s2_situation: Every morning a man goes to the garage, looks at his bicycle, and takes the car. Every night he returns, parks the car, and looks at the bicycle again.
sinister_s2_solution: The man has a terrible memory. He uses the bicycle as a visual reference to remember where he parked the car.
sinister_s3_situation: A woman enters a restaurant, reads the menu in silence, and points to her throat. The waiter brings the soup of the day.
sinister_s3_solution: She lost her voice due to laryngitis. The waiter knew she always orders the soup of the day and understood the gesture.
sinister_s4_situation: A man enters the cinema room, sits for 5 minutes, and leaves. He does this every Saturday for years.
sinister_s4_solution: He is the projectionist. He checks if the movie started correctly and if the audience is watching.
sinister_s5_situation: A man runs a marathon and finishes last. Still, he celebrates with a big smile.
sinister_s5_solution: He was running to raise money for charity. The longer he took, the more his sponsors donated. Finishing last was the best possible outcome.
sinister_s6_situation: A woman looks at an old photo and says 'That's not me.' She is right. But the photo is of herself as a child.
sinister_s6_solution: She has an identical twin sister. In the photo, both are together, but she confused which one is her. The one she pointed to is her sister.
sinister_s7_situation: A man opens a birthday present and finds an empty box. He is very happy and hugs the giver.
sinister_s7_solution: The gift was a safe. The box was empty because he should save his money there. It was encouragement to start saving.
sinister_s8_situation: A woman receives a letter, reads it silently, and starts crying with joy. The letter has no good news.
sinister_s8_solution: The letter was from an old love she thought was dead. He was alive, but wrote to say he moved on. She cried from relief that he was well.
sinister_s9_situation: A man boards a commercial airplane without a ticket. The flight attendant checks his documents and lets him fly.
sinister_s9_solution: He is the pilot of the airplane. Pilots don't need tickets, only valid identification and licenses.
sinister_s10_situation: Man receives expensive watch as gift. The watch keeps running slow. He never fixes it. The day after his birthday, he thanks for the gift.
sinister_s10_solution: The slow watch made him miss a train that derailed. The defect saved his life.
sinister_s11_situation: A man is found dead in the middle of the desert, next to a large puddle of water. There are no footprints around the body.
sinister_s11_solution: He fell from a hot air balloon that was flying over the desert. The puddle is what remained of the balloon's water ballast.
sinister_s12_situation: A woman cooks dinner for her husband. He eats, compliments the food, and dies minutes later.
sinister_s12_solution: The woman had been slowly poisoning her husband. But this time she didn't add poison. The husband had a severe peanut allergy and she used peanut oil for the first time.
sinister_s13_situation: A family of four goes camping in the forest. Only the father returns alive. Police investigate and don't charge him.
sinister_s13_solution: Sudden flash flood at night. Mother and children were swept away by the current. Father survived by climbing a tree. Natural accident.
sinister_s14_situation: A man looks in the bathroom mirror and doesn't recognize his own face. He doesn't scream or run. He just stares in silence.
sinister_s14_solution: He has prosopagnosia, a condition that prevents the brain from recognizing faces, including his own. He is used to this feeling.
sinister_s15_situation: A man leaves home during a storm and never returns. The next day, police find his body near a fallen power pole. There are no signs of violence.
sinister_s15_solution: He was an electrician who went out to fix the power grid damaged by the storm. A live wire fell into a puddle where he was standing, electrocuting him.
sinister_s16_situation: A child blows out the birthday cake candles and all the guests die. The child survives.
sinister_s16_solution: The guests were allergic to a secret ingredient in the cake. The child's family knew and put it on purpose. The child didn't eat the cake.
sinister_s17_situation: A man enters a train, sits down, and is never seen again. No one saw him leave.
sinister_s17_solution: He died of a heart attack shortly after entering. The body was hidden behind the seat. When the train reached the end of the line, cleaning staff removed the body quietly.
sinister_s18_situation: A couple spends the night in a mountain cabin. In the morning, only one leaves alive. There was no murder.
sinister_s18_solution: One of them had a terminal illness and went to the cabin to die in peace. The other just accompanied. It was a natural death.
sinister_s19_situation: School bus driver drives empty to school every day. No one questions. One day he is arrested red-handed.
sinister_s19_solution: He used the bus to transport drugs hidden in the seats. Police received a tip and did a surprise search.
sinister_s20_situation: Millionaire dies and leaves fortune to gardener. Family contests. Court upholds decision.
sinister_s20_solution: Gardener was millionaire's illegitimate son. DNA test proved paternity. He was the legitimate heir.
ws_select_first: Select the first letter of the found word
ws_select_last: Now select the last letter of the found word
ws_select_endpoints: You must select the first and last letter of the found word
sudoku_incorrect: There are errors on the board!
